description: Positive/mitigating finding, included for completeness: the real-order branch (run.sh:19-22) is currently a hardcoded no-op regardless of gate state ('real executor not wired yet; paper-only build increment', exit 0) — so no path in the CURRENT code can place a real order or spend real USDC. This is verified by reading run.sh in full; the file contains no wallet key handling, no HTTP POST to a CLOB order endpoint, and no signing code anywhere. However, there is zero automated test asserting this invariant (no bats/shell test exercising DRY_RUN=false EARN_MODE=execute PM_PAPER_PASS=1 and asserting the output still says 'execute-blocked' and never contains a real order id) — the only thing standing between the current safe behavior and a future silent regression is a code comment, not a test.

evidence.snippet:
echo '{"slot":"earn/pm-trade","mode":"execute-blocked","note":"real executor not wired yet; paper-only build increment","paper_gate":1}'
  exit 0
